info.title: @ackplus/nest-auth API
info.description:
Authentication & authorization API for **@ackplus/nest-auth**.

### Conventions
- **Base URL** — routes are shown relative to your app’s global prefix. The reference example app uses `/api`, so a route like `POST /auth/login` is called at `POST /api/auth/login`.
- **Auth** — most endpoints require a Bearer access token: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. The **Admin** endpoints use an httpOnly session cookie set by `POST /auth/admin/login`.
- **Token modes** — in *header* mode (default) tokens are returned in the response body; in *cookie* mode they are set as httpOnly cookies. Controlled by `accessTokenType`.
- **Errors** — failures return `{ statusCode, error, message, code }`; the machine-readable `code` is the value to branch on.

Browse by section in the sidebar: **Authentication**, **Password**, **Verification**, **Passwordless**, **MFA**, and the **Admin** groups.

phone.description: User phone number (required if email not provided)

guard.description: Guard context (e.g. admin, web, vendor) for isolation. Deprecated: use client

message.description: Success message (added by controller based on configuration)

mustChangePassword.description: True when the user must set a new password before using the app (e.g. an admin-set temporary password). Route them to the change-password screen.

mfaMethods.description: Available MFA methods when isRequiresMfa is true

trustToken.description: Trust token for trusted device verification

tenantId.description: Tenant to invite the member into (ISOLATED: the same email is a distinct account per tenant).

metadata.description: Optional metadata stored on a new user and echoed on the invite event for your email template.

token.description: OAuth token or ID token from social provider

type.description: How to interpret the supplied token. Required only for Google: `idToken` (default) verifies a Google-signed ID token client-side; `accessToken` calls Google's userinfo endpoint with a Bearer access token. Other providers (Facebook, Apple, GitHub) ignore this field.

name.description: Full display name from the provider. Apple only returns the user's name on the FIRST native sign-in, so pass it here to persist it (ignored by other providers). Prefer `firstName`/`lastName` when you have them separately.

firstName.description: User's given/first name captured by the frontend. Needed for Apple Sign In, which returns the name to the app ONLY on the first authorization (never in the id_token on later logins) — capture it then and send it here. Ignored by providers that already supply a name.

lastName.description: User's family/last name captured by the frontend (see `firstName`). Needed for Apple Sign In on the first authorization.

avatarUrl.description: Avatar / profile-picture URL supplied by the frontend. Apple Sign In does NOT provide a photo, so pass one here only if your app sourced it elsewhere. Google returns its own `picture`, used as a fallback when this is omitted.

nonce.description: Nonce used for native sign-in replay protection. When provided, it must match the `nonce` claim in the verified Apple identityToken.

identifier.description: Email or phone (same value as in send request)

channels.description: Channel(s) to try in order. Use both when the client is unsure whether `identifier` is email or phone.

code.description: One-time code from email or SMS

credentials.description: Login credentials - type varies by provider

passwordlessOtp.summary: Passwordless OTP — set providerName to passwordless (after POST /auth/passwordless/send)

guard.description: Guard context (e.g. admin, web, vendor) for isolation. Deprecated: use client

createUserIfNotExists.description: Auto-create user if not exists (for social auth)

rememberMe.description: "Remember me". In cookie mode, `false` issues SESSION cookies that clear when the browser closes (good for shared devices); `true`/omitted keeps the persistent cookies. The choice is sticky across token refresh. In header mode the client decides persistence by its storage adapter.

isMfaEnabled.description: Whether MFA is enabled for this user
